entry.title: More than one language in family life
entry.summary: The authors describe familiar people, places and routines as ways a baby can meet more than one language. Their examples offer different arrangements for different families.
entry.cue: More than one language is part of your baby’s family or community.
detail: One example gives each caregiver a language to use with the baby. Another connects languages with particular places or times, such as home, outings or weekends.
Books, play and conversation with people who speak a language are further possibilities. These arrangements need to fit the people and resources a family has.
